title: Bajaj Life Insurance launches innovation-focused equity fund under ULIP wrapper - The HinduBusinessLine
text:
The fund’s stock selection process narrows an investable universe of over 700 companies down to a focused portfolio of 30 to 40 high-conviction stocks.

Bajaj Life Insurance on Monday launched the Bajaj Life Pure Stock Innovation Fund, an equity fund available through its Unit Linked Insurance Plans (ULIPs), with the New Fund Offer (NFO) open from November 16 to November 27, 2026. The fund targets Indian businesses that are creating, adopting, or benefiting from innovation, and is benchmarked against the Nifty 500 Index.

The fund follows a market-cap agnostic strategy, investing across large, mid, and small-cap stocks. Its stock selection process narrows an investable universe of over 700 companies down to a focused portfolio of 30 to 40 high-conviction stocks. Selection criteria include business fundamentals, financial strength, growth prospects, and valuations — consistent with the Growth at a Reasonable Price (GARP) philosophy that underpins Bajaj Life’s existing Pure Stock Fund, which has a 20-year track record.

The fund excludes companies engaged in gambling, liquor, tobacco, hotels, entertainment, and contests. Innovation assessment will cover products, processes, technology, supply chains, and business models, with emphasis on commercial viability, scalability, and competitive sustainability.

MD and CEO Tarun Chugh said the fund aims to give customers exposure to India’s innovation-driven growth while maintaining financial security through the life insurance component bundled with ULIPs.

Bajaj Life currently manages assets worth ₹1.47 lakh crore, maintains a claim settlement ratio of 99.33 per cent for FY 2025–26, and operates through 599 branches and over 1.64 lakh insurance consultants across India.
